sources.title: CCNL Cooperative sociali 2023-2025, testo completo (edizione Legacoopsociali 2025)
Legacoop, circolare 1 febbraio 2024 (rev. 1.1): rinnovo del CCNL cooperative sociali, tabelle dei minimi
CNEL T151: verbale di accordo per il rinnovo del CCNL Cooperative sociali, 26 gennaio 2024
CNEL T151: verbale di scioglimento della riserva, 5 marzo 2024, con le tabelle del costo

notes.text: CONSOLIDATED MINIMUMS: base_salary is the minimo contrattuale conglobato mensile of Art. 76 (PDF p. 106) of the Legacoopsociali full text 2025, the same figures as the Legacoop circular of 1 February 2024 and the Ministry D.D. 30/2024 cost tables. Hourly divisor 165 for 38 hours a week (Art. 75). Level B is position B1 of Art. 76.

QUADRO LEVELS: levels E2Q, F1Q, F2Q are modelled as separate levels with fixed_allowances (function allowance EUR 77.47, EUR 154.94, EUR 232.41/month respectively). The base_salary is identical to the corresponding non-Q level; the allowance is fixed and unchanged across tranches. Seniority increments for Q levels carry the same amount as the corresponding base level.

ADDITIONAL MONTHS: 13 until 31 December 2024 (thirteenth month only). From 1 January 2025: 13.5 (thirteenth month + fourteenth month equal to 50% of one monthly salary, paid in June, introduced by the 26 January 2024 renewal).

TRANCHES: February 2024, October 2024 and October 2025 ('con la mensilità di febbraio 2024 / ottobre 2024 / ottobre 2025', verbale 26 January 2024, reserve lifted 5 March 2024). The CCNL 2023-2025 expired on 31 December 2025 (Art. 7); no renewal, una tantum or IVC was found through October 2026, so the October 2025 minimi stay in force.

LEVELS WITH THE SAME BASE: C3 and D1 have identical minimums at each tranche (orders 6/7). D3 and E1 are identical (orders 9/10). Q levels (E2Q/F1Q/F2Q) have the same base as the non-Q level but the next order: the engine allows equal salaries between adjacent levels.

SENIORITY INCREMENTS: one scatto per biennio, at most 5 (Art. 80, pp. 110-111). C3 is printed 20,63 in Art. 80 but 20.66 in the D.D. 30/2024 and CNEL cost tables and in the D1 row: 20.66 kept as derived. Apprentices accrue none (Art. 28 I.5, apprentice_amount 0); the recognised seniority of a qualified ex-apprentice starts at the end of the apprenticeship (caller's SeniorityFact).

APPRENTICESHIP (professionalizzante, Art. 28 L and N, PDF pp. 59-60): category A (A2) and the OSS of C2 18 months (85% / 90% at month 10); categories B and C (B, C1, C3) 24 months (85% / 90% at month 13); D and E 36 months (85% / 90% at month 19), on the minimo of the target position. A1, F and the health profiles are excluded (Art. 28 B.3).

INPS: the tax_sector terziario applies the terziario employer rates (29.31% to 30.11%), while the Ministry D.D. 30/2024 cost tables agreed by the signatories (PDF p. 186) apply 'Inps (28,03%)' to every level. Social cooperatives are classified by INPS by their activity; no primary INPS circular for their contribution set was read, so the difference is not reconciled.

limitation.remediation: Read the INPS classification of social cooperatives and model their employer rate set.

notes.text: TYPE-B COOPERATIVES: the contributions on the pay of the disadvantaged workers of type-B social cooperatives 'sono ridotte a zero' (L. 381/1991 art. 4 c. 3, PDF p. 248; c. 3-bis for detainees by decree). The request has no field for such a worker: the full rates apply.

limitation.remediation: Add a disadvantaged-worker input and zero the contributions of L. 381/1991 art. 4.

notes.text: NOT MODELLED AMOUNTS: the ETDR of the educatori (EUR 41, then 82 a month in 2025, Art. 47 and verbale 17 September 2025; the educatori socio-pedagogici move to D2 from 1 January 2026); the night allowance of EUR 12.39 / 6.20 per night and the 10% of night-only custody staff (Art. 54); 15% on Sunday and holiday ordinary hours (Art. 55); the 10% shift allowance (Art. 56); reperibilità in struttura EUR 77.47 a month plus EUR 20 a night (Art. 57); pronta disponibilità EUR 1.55 an hour (Art. 58); the indennità professionali (Art. 78) and the EUR 50 affiancamento allowance; the indennità di cassa EUR 30.99 (Art. 81); the extra 1/26 of a holiday on the rest day (Art. 59) and the 4 days of ex festività (Art. 60); the 26 hours of night workers' permessi (Art. 54); the PTR (Art. 10, outside every institute); the salari di primo ingresso of type B (Art. 2 B.4); the territorial gradualità agreements (Art. 77); the maternity integration (Art. 63); the 100% integration of work injury to day 180 (Art. 72); the ASI contribution of EUR 5, then 10 a month (Art. 87); the EUR 10 quota d'iscrizione of Previdenza Cooperativa (Art. 86). Sickness: no integration during the prova (Art. 71, Art. 28 M) and the comporto of 12 months in three years are not inputs. Apprenticeship: the 24-month track of the educatore professionale with title (Art. 28 N.2) is not expressible by level.

limitation.remediation: Model the ETDR, the night, shift and availability allowances, the professional allowances and the prova exclusion of sickness.

reviews.scope: Whole file. The values checked were not recorded.
findings: The review recorded no list of the documents it read.

reviews.scope: Every payable rule read again in the Legacoopsociali full text 2025 of the CCNL Cooperative sociali 2023-2025, with the Legacoop circular of 1 February 2024 and the CNEL T151 deposits of 26 January and 5 March 2024, for the reviewed tier.
findings: 83 records verified; the two aggregator sources replaced by the Legacoopsociali full text.
32 salary periods differed by 1-3 cents from Art. 76 (A1, B, C3, D1, D3, E1, E2, E2Q, F2, F2Q, and F1, F1Q from October 2025): corrected.
Ferie 26 working days on a six-day week (Art. 60), not 20.
Sickness: 100% of the normale retribuzione from day 1 to day 180 (Art. 71), no 50% carenza.
Apprenticeship: the OSS of C2 on the 18-month track (Art. 28 N.3); apprentices accrue no seniority (Art. 28 I.5): the apprentice_seniority limitation closed.
Added Previdenza Cooperativa (Art. 86: employer 1.5%, worker minimum 1% of the TFR base).
C3 seniority 20.66 stays derived: Art. 80 prints 20,63, the cost tables 20.66.
Absence by_26 stays derived: Art. 41 deducts hours at 1/165.
Open: the INPS rate of the cost tables (28.03%) vs terziario, and the type-B exemptions of L. 381/1991.
The CCNL expired on 31 December 2025; no renewal found through October 2026.
